veranderings.blok: Medisyne help, maar net vir die regte mens
veranderings.voor: meer drink as die etiket sê
veranderings.na: meer drink as wat die etiket sê
veranderings.rede: A comparison with a clause after 'meer ... as' normally takes 'as wat' in standard Afrikaans.
'albei' is the standard written form; 'altwee' is more colloquial.
'die mens' can read as people in general; 'die persoon' points clearly to the one who swallowed something.

veranderings.na: kook of verwarm hul huis met 'n paraffienstoof
veranderings.rede: 'verwarm' is transitive and needs an object; without one the sentence feels unfinished.

veranderings.na: sodat hy vir hulp kan bel
veranderings.rede: The instruction reads as a stated fact; 'sodat hy ... kan bel' links calling the adult to the purpose naturally.
The idiomatic form is plural: 'die vlamme slaan op'.

veranderings.voor: om uit te kom en nie om vuur te blus nie
veranderings.na: om uit te kom, nie om die vuur te blus nie
veranderings.rede: The contrast 'X, nie Y nie' is the natural Afrikaans pattern, and 'die vuur' refers to the fire just described.

veranderings.na: Los dit en vertel 'n grootmens daarvan.
veranderings.rede: 'vertel' without what is told sounds incomplete; 'vertel ... daarvan' is the idiomatic form.

vlae.blok: Medisyne help, maar net vir die regte mens
vlae.teks: Dit doen ook skade as iemand meer drink as die etiket sê.
vlae.rede: Not a safety flag: 'die etiket sê' here is about the dose, not about what is in the container, so it is not the withdrawn wording; noted only so the reviewer can confirm.

vlae.teks: Gif in korrels, blokkies of lokaas wat rotte doodmaak as hulle dit vreet.
vlae.rede: 'lokaas' is the bait itself rather than a form like 'korrels' or 'blokkies', so the list mixes kinds; fixing it would need the writer to choose the intended content.
